page.overview:
Who is Alien?

Alien is an extraterrestrial seen on the Simpsons’ couch.

The Alien is seen on the family couch drinking Buzz Cola. When he sees the family coming, he pulls a string and jumps down a hatch. The family then sit normally, never noticing the Alien.
